recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No additional core source edit is needed for FHIR-43646; future changes to ActorDefinition wording should be handled under a new tracker or the specific later issue changing the actor taxonomy.
issue_request: FHIR-43646 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 clarification for FHIR-core ActorDefinition asking that application-only ActorDefinition wording be changed to include a human or system.
initial_application: Commit 53dc7647943a1bff90d2177ccf6c2d070c8e75d5 from PR #3192 applied the seed by changing the root ActorDefinition short description from "An application that exchanges data" to "A human or system that exchanges data," but did not itself align every nearby longer description.
additional_context: FHIR-43805 was resolved as the same as FHIR-43646, and the combined branch already contains commit 8c1e1ee2bf9c90a8713a262de86b3e9c6edec8be aligning the remaining StructureDefinition.description. Later applied issues FHIR-43469 and FHIR-44475 refined the approved actor taxonomy to systems, individuals, non-system devices, or collectives.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source/actordefinition/structuredefinition-ActorDefinition.xml description and root definition are already consistent with the seed decision as refined by later same-family ActorDefinition decisions.

related_jiras.note: Explicitly resolved by reference to FHIR-43646 and already reconciled the remaining StructureDefinition.description wording on the combined branch.
Updated ActorDefinition short and definition wording after FHIR-43646 to align with the expanded actor taxonomy.
Established the broader actor type set that explains why current text says system, individual, non-system device, or collective rather than only human/system.
